data.headline: Annotation
data.text: Imagine a world in which vehicles navigate independently, machines make decisions independently, and networked systems interoperate seamlessly. In the Master´s degree programme in "Embedded and Autonomous Systems" at the Westsächsischen Hochschule Zwickau, you will become part of this future. Dive into the fascinating world of embedded and autonomous systems and actively help shape the technologies of tomorrow.
